name: Symbol Index
summary: Tree-sitter driven symbol extractor that parses six languages (typescript, tsx, javascript, jsx, python, go, rust) via bundled WASM grammars and per-language .scm queries, then exposes the results through a SymbolOracle that supports name-based, file-based, and export-filtered lookups.
keyPoints: extractFile is the single-file entry point: it loads the grammar for the requested language, runs the language's .scm query against the tree, and returns a FileMap via the collect() helper, which only keeps records whose kind is in KINDS (function, method, class, interface, type, struct, enum, trait, impl, const, var, module).

Export visibility is determined by walking outward from the declaration to unwrap DOC_WRAPPERS (export_statement, decorated_definition, lexical_declaration, variable_declaration, expression_statement); Python uses a separate pythonDocstring path and isExported also checks hasExportAncestor plus restricted-member rules, so TS/JS, Rust, Go, and Python each have distinct export semantics in one place.

grammars.ts keeps a Promise-cached loader so each language's WASM and .scm query is fetched at most once via loadGrammar(); newParser() returns a Parser already configured for a Language, and oracle.ts builds two indexes from an IndexResult — byName for cross-file symbol resolution (with unknownNames/exported filters) and byPath for per-file FileMap access via hasFile/file/lookupIn.

entryPoints.name: extractFile
entryPoints.note: Main per-file entry: parses source with tree-sitter, runs the language's query, and returns a FileMap of SymbolRecord entries.

entryPoints.name: loadGrammar
entryPoints.note: Resolves and caches a language's WASM grammar plus its .scm query file, returning a LoadedGrammar or null for unsupported languages.

entryPoints.name: newParser
entryPoints.note: Constructs a tree-sitter Parser wired to a Language, the lower-level building block extractFile relies on.

entryPoints.name: SymbolOracle
entryPoints.note: Queryable view over an IndexResult exposing lookup/has/lookupIn/hasFile/file/unknownNames/exported/symbolCount for downstream consumers.
